verdict.rationale: Dedicated IPs and warmup are a fair question for an email-sending service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions dedicated IPs, IP pools, automated warmup or a published warmup schedule. The cited docs cover only the Mail Send API, SMTP, sandbox mode, webhooks, domain authentication, templates and Deliverability Insights.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools
